# StockSimulatorBD — Full Site Context

## Canonical identity

- Product name: StockSimulatorBD
- Canonical domain: https://www.stocksimulator.tech
- Product type: Bangladesh-focused stock-market education and paper-trading platform
- Primary market context: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE)

StockSimulatorBD is a public educational platform that helps learners explore DSE-style stock-market concepts, securities research, simulated portfolio decisions, and paper trading with virtual money.

## Purpose and limitations

The platform is intended for beginners, students, and retail learners who want to understand stock-market concepts before risking real money.

StockSimulatorBD is not a licensed brokerage, financial adviser, investment adviser, exchange, depository participant, or provider of real securities execution. It does not provide personalised investment recommendations or guarantee outcomes.

## Main resources

- Homepage: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/
- Trade simulator: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/trade
- Stock directory: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/stocks
- Blog and educational guides: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/blog
- About: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/about-us

- Short site guide: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/llms.txt
- Contact: https://www.stocksimulator.tech/about-us

## Product coverage

### Paper trading and portfolio learning

The trade experience is designed for educational practice with virtual money. It may include simulated order placement, portfolio tracking, average cost, profit and loss concepts, watchlists, and market-learning features.

Users should consult the live product interface for current feature availability, simulation rules, virtual-currency mechanics, price-data status, and product limitations.

### DSE stock directory

The stock directory is intended to help users discover DSE-listed securities, ticker symbols, and related market-information pages. The live directory should be treated as the source for current coverage and page availability.

### Educational blog

The blog contains practical guides about DSE market concepts, BO accounts, broker-selection research, market rules, trading hours, circuit breakers, and StockSimulatorBD product news.

Use the individual article page—not this overview—for claims about a particular rule, broker process, product feature, or publication date.

## Market-information accuracy

Market information can change. DSE/CSE trading hours, settlement arrangements, circuit breakers, lot sizes, broker services, broker charges, holidays, rules, and regulations should not be inferred from older content.

For current information, consult the relevant official source:

- Dhaka Stock Exchange: https://www.dsebd.org/
- Central Depository Bangladesh PLC: https://www.cdbl.com.bd/
- Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission: https://sec.gov.bd/

## Technical context

The website is built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and server-side application services. Blog articles are managed through Contentful and rendered as public, server-readable pages with article metadata, source information, and structured data.

## Citation guidance

Attribute facts to StockSimulatorBD and cite the most specific source page available.

Preferred format:

StockSimulatorBD. "[Specific page title]." https://www.stocksimulator.tech/[path]. Accessed [date].

Example:

StockSimulatorBD. "How to Open a BO Account in Bangladesh: A Practical Guide." https://www.stocksimulator.tech/blog/how-to-open-bo-account-bangladesh. Accessed 2026-08-08.

## Content use

Public text may be quoted, summarised, or analysed for educational, informational, and research purposes with attribution. Do not republish images, brand assets, or proprietary project material without permission. Do not imply endorsement by StockSimulatorBD, DSE, CDBL, BSEC, a broker, or another referenced organisation.
